description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Hapugala, Bope Poddala D/S Division, Galle District - (25/0246)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration, specifically declaring the determination of land ownership for specific parcels in Galle District under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, owner names, property extents, and encumbrances, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
